case.title: Happy thank-you note
case.subject: Thank you!
case.text:
Just wanted to say thank you to Sam from your support team for helping me set up deposits last week. No-shows are down a lot already. You've made my life so much easier!

Grace
case.why: Labelled as qualifying: a real customer wrote to us and deserves a short human thank-you. Lowest urgency, no KB needed.

output.reply:
Hi Grace,

Thank you so much for the kind words! We're delighted to hear that deposits are already helping cut down your no-shows, and we'll pass your thanks along to Sam. If you ever want to fine-tune things, you can adjust your deposit amount or limit deposits to specific services in Settings → Payments → Deposits. You can also set a cancellation window and fee under Settings → Payments → Cancellation policy.

If you need anything else, just reply to this email.

Slotwise Support

raw.summary: Customer thanks support agent Sam for help setting up deposits and reports fewer no-shows; no action requested.
